missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness rather than network
candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) hits a transport ReadTimeout; payment is the slow downstream, propagating 502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show client-side ReadTimeout to payment; payment-side telemetry absent, so cause could be payment slowness or network.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s (~2s) correlate with order->payment ReadTimeout errors in traces; inventory/redis calls succeed. Payment is the failing downstream, consistent with downstream-latency. Payment-side telemetry is unavailable, so confidence is moderate.
